d: A major crackdown on an illegal human egg harvesting racket is underway in Hyderabad following joint raids by Telangana’s Malkajgiri police and Health and Medical Department officials. Authorities issued notices to 13 Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) centres out of 44 identified facilities and arrested middlemen and property owners linked to the network.
